camel_example: aliyun polardb DescribeDetachedBackups --region cn-hangzhou --BackupRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --EndTime '2020-05-14T00:00Z' --PageSize 30 --PageNumber 1 --BackupMode Manual --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000000' --StartTime '2020-05-01T00:00Z' --BackupId 111111111 --BackupStatus Success
description_en: Queries the information about the backup sets in a released PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 查询已被释放的PolarDB集群中备份集详情
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-detached-backups --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --backup-id 111111111 --backup-status Success --backup-mode Manual --backup-region cn-hangzhou --start-time 2020-05-01T00:00Z --end-time 2020-05-14T00:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDetachedBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed
parameters.help_zh:
备份状态，取值范围如下：
Success：备份完成
Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下： 
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The region where the cross-region data backup file of the instance is stored.

This parameter is valid only for PolarDB for MySQL clusters
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份的目的地域。

当前仅PolarDB MySQL版支持该参数
parameters.name: backup_region

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值范围如下： 
30
50
100

默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup task. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 本次备份结束时间（UTC时间）

BackupId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupMethod.description_en: The backup method. Only snapshot backups are supported. The value is set to Snapshot
BackupMethod.description_zh: 数据备份方法，仅支持快照备份，取值固定为Snapshot

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下： 
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

BackupSetSize.description_en:
The size of the backup set. Unit: bytes.

After you delete the target snapshot backups, the storage space consumed by the backups is released. The released storage space is smaller than the size of the backup file, because the snapshots share certain data blocks
BackupSetSize.description_zh:
备份文件大小，单位为Byte。

因为快照之间存在共享数据块，因此删除目标快照备份后释放的空间会远小于该备份文件的大小

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup task. The time is displayed in UTC
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 本次备份开始时间（UTC时间）

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success
Failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份状态，取值范围如下：
Success：备份完成
Failed：备份失败

BackupType.description_en: The type of the backup. Only full backups are supported. The value is set to FullBackup
BackupType.description_zh: 备份类型，仅支持全量备份，取值固定为FullBackup

BackupsLevel.description_en:
The level of the backup set. Valid values:

Level-1: level-1 backup set
Level-2: level-2 backup set
BackupsLevel.description_zh:
备份集级别，取值范围如下：
Level-1：一级备份
Level-2：二级备份

ConsistentTime.description_en: The snapshot checkpoint time. The value is a Unix timestamp
ConsistentTime.description_zh: 一致性快照的时间点，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为秒

IsAvail.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set is available. Valid values:

0: The data backup set is unavailable.
1: The data backup set is available
IsAvail.description_zh:
备份集是否可用，取值范围如下：
0：不可用
1：可用

StoreStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the backup set can be deleted. Valid values:

Enabled: The backup set can be deleted.
Disabled: The backup set cannot be deleted
StoreStatus.description_zh:
是否允许删除备份集，取值范围如下：
Enabled：允许删除
Disabled：不允许删除

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
